purpose.summary: This program is a supplemental package diagnostics COBOL routine for an ADS/RPS system. It provides multiple entry points to open/close/reopen an indexed file (ADSPF015), perform barcode lookups against that file, and return supplemental package data (PO number, invoice number, customer reference, department, date) to the caller. It also maintains an error log file (ERRORCOBLOG) for file I/O errors.
purpose.domain: logistics/shipping (barcode-based package tracking, likely postal or parcel)

verdict.notes: The file is clearly production COBOL from RPS, Inc. (a shipping/logistics company). The change log references an EPIC change in 2011 for 34-digit barcodes, indicating active maintenance. The COPY statement references an absolute path on a Linux/UNIX system (/home/oasis/include/ads-pf015), so the copybook content is not visible here. The use of COMP-X and ENTRY statements strongly suggests Micro Focus or ACUCOBOL-GT dialect running on Linux/UNIX.
